keys: A pool table that shows its own physics. Play eight-ball or nine-ball against the computer, and see why every shot went where it did.
Eight-ball or nine-ball against the computer, or practise on your own.
Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.
A full game with turns and a score.
Score as much as you can before the clock runs out.

translations.key: A pool table that shows its own physics. Play eight-ball or nine-ball against the computer, and see why every shot went where it did.
translations.text: Una mesa de billar que muestra su propia física. Juega a la bola ocho o a la bola nueve contra el ordenador, y mira por qué cada tiro fue a donde fue.

translations.key: A pool table that shows its own physics. Play eight-ball or nine-ball against the computer, and see why every shot went where it did.
translations.text: Une table de billard qui montre sa propre physique. Joue au huit ou au neuf contre l'ordinateur, et vois pourquoi chaque coup est allé là où il est allé.

translations.key: A pool table that shows its own physics. Play eight-ball or nine-ball against the computer, and see why every shot went where it did.
translations.text: Ein Billardtisch, der seine eigene Physik zeigt. Spiel 8-Ball oder 9-Ball gegen den Computer und sieh, warum jeder Stoß dorthin ging, wo er hinging.

translations.text: Un tavolo da biliardo che mostra la propria fisica. Gioca a palla 8 o palla 9 contro il computer, e scopri perché ogni colpo è andato dove è andato.

translations.key: A pool table that shows its own physics. Play eight-ball or nine-ball against the computer, and see why every shot went where it did.
translations.text: Uma mesa de snooker que mostra a sua própria física. Joga bola 8 ou bola 9 contra o computador, e vê porque cada tacada foi para onde foi.

translations.text: 自分の物理を見せてくれるビリヤード台。コンピューターとエイトボールやナインボールで遊び、どのショットもなぜそこへ行ったのかを見てみよう。

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Toca Lente para ver la física: las trayectorias magenta son bolas deslizándose, las cian son bolas rodando; cuanto más gruesa, más rápida. Arrastra la barra para recorrer el tiro en cualquiera de los dos sentidos.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Touche Lentille pour voir la physique : les trajectoires magenta sont des billes qui glissent, les trajectoires cyan des billes qui roulent ; plus c'est épais, plus c'est rapide. Fais glisser la barre pour parcourir le coup dans les deux sens.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Tippe auf Lens, um die Physik zu sehen: Magentafarbene Linien zeigen gleitende Kugeln, türkisfarbene Linien rollende Kugeln, dickere Linien sind schneller. Ziehe die Leiste, um den Stoß in beide Richtungen durchzugehen.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Tocca Lens per vedere la fisica: le linee magenta indicano palle che scivolano, quelle turchesi palle che rotolano, quelle più spesse sono più veloci. Trascina la barra per scorrere il tiro in entrambe le direzioni.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Toca em Lente para ver a física: os trajetos magenta são bolas a deslizar, os ciano são bolas a rolar, quanto mais grosso mais rápido. Arrasta a barra para percorrer a tacada nos dois sentidos.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Toque em Lente para ver a física: os trajetos magenta são bolas deslizando, os ciano são bolas rolando, quanto mais grosso mais rápido. Arraste a barra para percorrer a tacada nos dois sentidos.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: レンズをタップすると物理の動きが見られます。マゼンタの線は滑っている球、水色の線は転がっている球で、線が太いほど速く動いています。バーをドラッグすると、ショットを前後どちらにもたどれます。

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: 렌즈를 탭하면 물리 움직임이 보입니다. 자홍색 선은 미끄러지는 공, 청록색 선은 구르는 공이고, 선이 굵을수록 빠릅니다. 바를 드래그하면 샷을 앞뒤로 살펴볼 수 있습니다.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: 点击透镜查看物理现象：洋红色轨迹是滑动的球，青色轨迹是滚动的球，线越粗速度越快。拖动进度条，可以向前或向后浏览整个击球过程。

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Нажми «Линза», чтобы увидеть физику: пурпурные линии означают скользящие шары, голубые катящиеся, чем толще линия, тем быстрее. Перетащи полосу, чтобы просмотреть удар в любом направлении.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: magenta paths are balls sliding, cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: انقر على العدسة لترى الفيزياء: المسارات بلون الماجنتا للكرات المنزلقة، والمسارات السماوية للكرات المتدحرجة، والأسمك أسرع. اسحب الشريط للتنقل في الضربة في الاتجاهين.

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.
translations.text: Tú y tu rival compartís mesa. Uno se queda las lisas, del 1 al 7, y el otro las rayadas, del 9 al 15. Mete todo tu grupo y luego la 8 para ganar.

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.
translations.text: Du und dein Gegner teilt euch einen Tisch. Einer nimmt die Vollen, 1 bis 7, der andere die Halben, 9 bis 15. Räum deine Gruppe ab und versenk dann die 8 zum Sieg.

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.
translations.text: Tu e il tuo avversario, un solo tavolo. Uno prende le piene, dall'1 al 7, l'altro le rigate, dal 9 al 15. Imbuca tutto il tuo gruppo, poi la 8 per vincere.

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.
translations.text: あなたと相手で1つの台を使います。一方は1番から7番のソリッド、もう一方は9番から15番のストライプ。自分のグループを全部落とし、最後に8番を沈めれば勝ちです。

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.
translations.text: 나와 상대가 한 테이블을 씁니다. 한쪽은 1번부터 7번까지 솔리드, 다른 쪽은 9번부터 15번까지 스트라이프를 맡습니다. 내 그룹을 모두 넣고 8번을 넣으면 승리합니다.

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.
translations.text: 你和对手共用一张球台。一方打 1 到 7 号全色球，另一方打 9 到 15 号花色球。打完自己的球组，再打进 8 号球即获胜。

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.
translations.text: Ты и соперник за одним столом. Один берёт сплошные, с 1 по 7, другой полосатые, с 9 по 15. Забей свою группу, затем восьмёрку, чтобы победить.

translations.key: You and your opponent share one table. One of you takes the solids, 1 to 7, the other the stripes, 9 to 15. Clear your group, then sink the 8 to win.
translations.text: أنت وخصمك تتشاركان طاولة واحدة. يأخذ أحدكما الكرات السادة من 1 إلى 7، والآخر المخططة من 9 إلى 15. أدخل مجموعتك كلها ثم الكرة 8 لتفوز.
